## Owner authorization

Parent #344; qualified H700 firmware from #555. Owner: “You have permission to transfer the build to the RG35xx SP and reboot it as well once you’re ready. It should still be online.”

This is one named RG35XX SP transfer and one reboot into accepted H70003, sourcebc9dfe8141, bundle66273ff16383957687af44728a9e4e2c4bf1242c0217cf681dca8abee858d9b7. No other device, game launch, screenshot, input or deliberate cloud operation. Existing #519 alignment is complete; read current state before acting and preserve current owner choices.

Can this be done on the VM? Shared changes and retained-storage upgrade are already qualified on VM20. This task verifies the actual RG35XX SP DDR4 board's updater, storage mounts and Tailnet return. Host hashes and read-only preservation inventory bind the physical update.

## Acceptance criteria

- [x] Fresh private preflight binds model/DTB/DRAM, firmware/boot, battery, free space, empty queue, quiet frontend/cloud processes, automatic-sync state, selected configuration and protected saves/recovery; sanitized receipt retained. No settings change inferred.
- [x] Qualified update tar is staged outside .update through device-act, exact device-side SHA256 passes, fresh state guards pass, and only then the complete file enters the update queue; all original stage channels and actual host exits recorded.
- [x] One approved reboot through device-act applies the update; actual new boot/build identity, SYSTEM/kernel/DTB/bootloader/changed executable hashes, expected mounts, frontend state and empty queue are recorded. Original reboot result and return polling retained.
- [x] Current protected saves/recovery, credentials and selected paths/settings preserve their bytes or documented semantic equivalence; no cloud or screenshot action occurred. Sanitized evidence updates device facts, #344/M7 and checkpoint; owner is told the observed result and remaining physical testing.

Completed23:22:36UTC. Stage/reboot original channels0 and actual owners exited; installed acceptance and all163 protected file/configuration/recovery comparisons pass. Owner released to normal use. Evidence: `docs/qa-logs/2026-10-11-device-refresh/rg35xxsp-deployment/`; current hardware facts updated. No screenshots, gameplay or cloud operation.
